details.message:
The input did not match the regular expression /CURRENT_TREE_V2/. Input:

'PROMETEO · UNIVERSAL SESSION PREFLIGHT V1\n' +
  'Status: BINDING CONTINUITY GUARD\n' +
  'Purpose: every fresh interactive chat/Guide/session and every material worker mutation must understand where it is in Prometeo before changing durable state.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'THIS DOES NOT CREATE A NEW AUTHORITY.\n' +
  'Current Tree, Organism, Work Context, source owners, Design DNA and the worker packet keep their existing roles.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'A · INTERACTIVE CHAT / GUIDE · BEFORE MATERIAL MUTATION\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Mandatory orientation order:\n' +
  '\n' +
  '1. CURRENT TREE V2\n' +
  '   Read the current continuity index first.\n' +
  '   Stable human entry:\n' +
  '   https://juanmanuelpm.github.io/prometeo/current-tree/\n' +
  '\n' +
  '2. CURRENT ARCHITECTURE\n' +
  '   Resolve which architecture is CURRENT and which candidates/legacy paths must not be resurrected.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '3. ORGANISM\n' +
  '   Read the Living Organism/current projection and locate the target object, its owner, parents, dependencies and related surfaces.\n' +
  '   Do not merely note that the organism exists: identify where your target sits and what can regress if it changes.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '4. OBJECTIVE / PLAN / CURRENT STATE\n' +
  "   Read the target project's current objective, plan/checkpoint, active constraints, latest durable decisions and exact next action.\n" +
  '   Prefer durable source owners over chat recollection.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '5. WORK CONTEXT / SESSION LINEAGE\n' +
  '   Reopen the relevant Work Context and, if this is a reincarnated chat, predecessor SESSION/JOURNAL.\n' +
  '   Exact prompts remain private by default. Public journal is continuity projection, not authority.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '6. DESIGN DNA / GOLDEN / PRESERVATION\n' +
  '   If the requested work can materially alter architecture, orchestration, persistence, recovery, global UI behavior, worker ABI, Guide coordination or a known-good product flow:\n' +
  '   read coordination/design-dna/INDEX.json and the required stack.\n' +
  '   Identify touched invariants, failure vaccines and last-known-good baseline before editing.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '7. DRIFT\n' +
  '   Compare:\n' +
  '   requested human delta\n' +
  '   vs current plan/objective\n' +
  '   vs current bytes/runtime evidence\n' +
  '   vs known baseline.\n' +
  '   State internally what changed since the last checkpoint.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Only then mutate durable state.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'B · CLASSIFY THE HUMAN REQUEST\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Every material human request must be treated as one of:\n' +
  '\n' +
  'CONTINUE\n' +
  '- advances the current plan without changing its contract.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'COMPATIBLE_DELTA\n' +
  '- adds or improves something while preserving current objective/baseline.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'EXPERIMENT\n' +
  '- explores a different option without replacing CURRENT.\n' +
  '- isolate it as candidate/alternative and retain comparison evidence.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'REPLAN\n' +
  '- intentionally changes objective/order/strategy.\n' +
  '- record what plan is being superseded, why, what is preserved, and exact rollback/history refs.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'DESTRUCTIVE_RESET\n' +
  '- explicitly asks to remove/rebuild/replace known-good behavior.\n' +
  '- obey the human directive, but do not silently erase history.\n' +
  '- preserve a rollbackable baseline/reference whenever technically possible unless the human explicitly requires irreversible destruction.\n' +
  '- record the destructive intent, previous plan, affected invariants and new target.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'A new request is NOT permission to forget the previous plan.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'If the human says something apparently contradictory or likely to move the project backward:\n' +
  '- do not ignore the human;\n' +
  '- explain/represent the conflict in the durable decision;\n' +
  '- prefer an isolated experiment/alternative when that satisfies the request;\n' +
  '- if the human clearly requests the replacement anyway, execute it within authority while preserving lineage/evidence.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'C · WORKER RULE\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'A worker must NOT use this preflight to choose project, task, priority, family or queue.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Worker order:\n' +
  '1. obtain fresh worker identity / dispatch through the CURRENT worker entrypoint required by its worker prompt;\n' +
  '2. if dispatch returns WORK, obey packet scope/tool_policy/authority;\n' +
  '3. BEFORE any material GitHub/runtime mutation:\n' +
  '   - read this preflight;\n' +
  '   - inspect Current Tree status relevant to the target;\n' +
  '   - locate the target in Organism / source-owner context when available;\n' +
  '   - read Design DNA only when the packet touches material architecture/global behavior;\n' +
  "   - preserve the packet's allowed_paths/done_when as the hard mutation boundary;\n" +
  '4. execute only the packet;\n' +
  '5. return evidence/results through the existing worker protocol.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Organism/context informs execution. It never expands worker authority.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'D · FRESH CHAT SESSION / REINCARNATION\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'Every adopted fresh chat:\n' +
  '1. creates a NEW session_id + session_pin;\n' +
  '2. links predecessor_session_id when continuing;\n' +
  '3. reads this preflight;\n' +
  '4. reads Current Tree + relevant Organism/objective/plan + predecessor journal/source owners;\n' +
  '5. publishes SESSION.json/JOURNAL.json/CONTINUE.txt before substantial long-lived work when the durable path is available;\n' +
  '6. journals every material turn before final reply:\n' +
  '   human intent summary, conclusion, real actions, refs, decisions, boundaries, next action;\n' +
  '7. never publishes raw private prompts, note bodies, tokens, Authorization headers or hidden chain-of-thought.\n' +
  '\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  'E · DEFINITION OF CONTINUITY SUCCESS\n' +
  '============================================================\n' +
  '\n' +
  'A fresh shell should be able to answer, from durable state:\n' +
  '\n' +
  '- WHAT is the human trying to achieve?\n' +
  '- WHERE does this object live in the organism?\n' +
  '- WHAT is CURRENT vs CANDIDATE/LEGACY?\n' +
  '- WHAT plan was active?\n' +
  '- WHY was that plan chosen?\n' +
  '- WHAT known-good behavior must survive?\n' +
  '- WHAT changed recently?\n' +
  '- WHAT did the human request now?\n' +
  '- IS it continuation, compatible delta, experiment, replan or destructive reset?\n' +
  '- WHAT exact next action is safe and authorized?\n' +
  '- WHERE will the result/journal/evidence be written?\n' +
  '\n' +
  'If any of those answers are materially unknown, inspect the existing owners before redesigning.\n' +
  '\n' +
  'CORE LAW:\n' +
  'HUMAN DIRECTIVE IS THE NEW INTENT.\n' +
  'DURABLE HISTORY IS THE CONTEXT.\n' +
  'NEW INTENT MAY CHANGE THE PLAN.\n' +
  'NEW INTENT MUST NOT SILENTLY ERASE THE REASONING, BASELINE OR LINEAGE THAT CAME BEFORE IT.\n'
